# ADR 0198: this project has a bynk.toml, so it compiles via Roots::Split
# and its reported diagnostic path re-bases against the include root (`src`)
# rather than staying tree-relative. Pinning `src/demo/gauge.bynk` here — not
# `demo/gauge.bynk` — proves that re-basing is observed; do not "fix" the
# path back to the tree-relative form if this test goes red.
